# fonts

Fonts: IBM Plex Sans for the UI (IBM's face for technical, instrument-like interfaces; its Light cut is the thin sans for annotations), Lilex Nerd Font for the terminal (a coding face with ligatures), JetBrains Mono Nerd Font for the bar, lock screen and notifications, Noto for coverage and emoji.

They are not part of the palette.

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`fonts/packages`): `inter-font` (the previous UI face, unused (IBM Plex Sans replaced it): sudo pacman -Rns inter-font, then drop this line), `ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd` (mono (bar, lock screen, notifications)), `ttf-lilex-nerd` (mono (terminal)), `noto-fonts`, `noto-fonts-cjk`, `noto-fonts-emoji`, `ttf-dejavu`, `ttf-ibm-plex`, `ttf-ibmplex-mono-nerd`, `ttf-liberation`, `ttf-nerd-fonts-symbols`, `ttf-nerd-fonts-symbols-mono`, `ttf-terminus-nerd`
